text:
Kai: Noticed oddness in cost dashboard: for tenant `orion`, cache_savings for `sparrow-mini` up 42% but per-invocation unit cost also rose. Suspect attribution mixup after routing policy change.

Ana: Can you share a minimal query that surfaces the delta?

Kai: Using econ-rollup: `SELECT route, model, SUM(tokens), SUM(cache_saved) FROM invocations WHERE tenant='orion' AND day='2026-03-20' GROUP BY 1,2`. Shows cache shift to new route but cost assigned to heavy fallback model.

Vik: Likely last-touch attribution (response route gets credit). When routing key changed, ownership moved. We discussed first-touch vs last-touch months ago.

Ana: Short mitigation: in dashboard, hide cache credits for invocations with `quota_status != 'allowed'` and add an annotation about routing changes.

Kai: Also propose a lightweight reattribution job: join kv_reads -> kv_writes by key for a 6h window and show diff. Small sample should run quick.

Vik: I'll mock SQL for that join and a console toggle (runtime-owner | writer-first) so PMs can flip in the card.

pager-bot: scheduled job `reattribute-5300000000` -> runs in 1h, sample=3% tenant=orion.

Kai: Thanks. Will post sample req_ids after job runs.
